name: [🎃] Clean the Moon!
desc:
🌕 CLEAN THE MOON 🧹

The Moon is a total mess, and you’re the only one who can fix it!

Suit up, grab your broom, and sweep moon dust, space junk, and meteor debris across the lunar surface. Sell what you collect, upgrade your gear, and build a base that cleans the Moon for you!

🧹 Sweep dust and debris to earn cash
🤖 Unlock cleaning robots to automate your work
🏗️ Build and expand your own lunar base
⚡ Upgrade your broom, backpack, and moon boots
🌑 Unlock new craters and zones as you progress
👨‍🚀 Team up with friends to clean faster together

Can you clean the ENTIRE Moon? 🌍

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new updates!
🔔 Join the group for exclusive rewards!
